assessment: The present work is noteworthy for explaining how DNA topoisomerase VI, an archaeal and plant based enzyme with homology to the Spo11 meiotic recombination core complex, senses DNA crossovers to preferentially remove positive supercoils and DNA catenanes. The findings are important for understanding how topoisomerase VI supports DNA replication and chromosome disentanglement.
